thread:
Alex S.: Quick heads-up — NeptuneHealth wants a 12h soak perf run tomorrow 10:00am PST. Goal: validate sustained 200 RPS with p95 <= 120ms for chat-style requests. Need checklist: load plan, model/quant config, allowlist IPs, and a rough cost estimate to share with their infra team. @Kai M. can you own the runner? @Maddy R. can you confirm model variant + perf expectation? Security bot: they sent a short SOC2 checklist, need a pointer to our public docs and temporary IPs.

Kai M.: I can spin up the devpool and run the soak. Couple quick Qs: what's the average request payload (tokens in / out)? streaming vs non-streaming? will they use function calls? Also do we want to shard across 2 GPUs or try single big host to match expected production?

Alex S.: Payload avg: prompt ~60 tokens, response ~120 tokens. Non-streaming for this test (they said no streaming for fairness). No function calls. Prefer to mirror their planned Dedicated config: 2xA100-equivalent. If we can show single-host perf too that helps.

Maddy R.: Recommend serving with redwood-large-quantized-v2 (INT8) for cost realism, fallback to FP16 on first warmup if we hit quality regressions. Expected baseline: ~80-140ms p95 at 200 RPS across 2 GPUs with continuous batching turned on. I'll bake a kernel/quant profile and attach a minimal config.

Maddy R.: Sample loadrunner config (we'll run a brief smoke then full soak):
```
concurrency: 200
arrival_rate: 200
payloads_file: samples/neptune_prompts.json
timeout: 60s
duration: 12h
headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>
endpoint: https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
I'll drop the samples + prompt set to the #poc-artifacts bucket.

Liam (SRE): I'll provision temporary allowlist and reserved IPs. List I'm adding: 34.201.12.8, 34.201.12.9. If NeptuneHealth wants peering we can coord later. Also will enable enhanced perf tracing and keep 1h retention for the run logs.

security-bot: Received NeptuneHealth SOC2 snippet. Public docs link: https://redwood.example/security/soc2-summary. For temporary credential rotation: we create a scoped API key for the POC that expires in 36h.

Alex S.: Pricing ask from their finance: estimate for 12h soak + 1 week of additional dedicated dev time to reproduce. Ballpark? include GPU cost + token egress.

Maddy R.: Rough compute estimate: 2x GPU reserved for 12h + prewarming runs ~16 GPU-hours total. At our internal devpool rate that's ~ $X_GPU * 16 = $2,400 (ballpark). Token egress for samples negligible for their dataset size; add a 10% contingency. I'll formalize numbers after the smoke run.

Kai M.: I'll start the smoke at 09:30 PST to validate configs, then ramp to full 12h soak at 10:00. Plan: 10m warmup, 30m steady at 50% load, then full sustained 200 RPS. Will post Prometheus and RT histos to the thread.

Alex S.: Perfect. Can everyone confirm ownerships so I can update the NeptuneHealth thread and invite them to the kickoff?

Kai M.: Own runner + logs.

Maddy R.: Own model config, quant profile, and perf expectations.

Liam (SRE): Own allowlist + IPs + retention settings.

security-bot: Will produce SOC2 link and scoped API key.

Alex S.: Great — I'll ping NeptuneHealth and share this plan. Please emoji react when you see the final invites :thumbsup:

Kai M.: Will post a short pre-run checklist here 30m before start with the exact curl to hit and a sample `wrk` line.

Maddy R.: Uploading prompts now. Expect initial numbers in the hour.

Liam (SRE): IPs are ready and I'll DM the keys once scoped key is created.

security-bot: Scoped key created: poc-neptune-2026 (expires in 36h)

Alex S.: Thanks team — filing this as the official POC soak run thread. Keeping notes minimal here so NeptuneHealth sees the live link.
